steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Umm... which one should I wear?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: This one's sort of tight, but this one has kind of short sleeves. This is the first time I've ever had so much trouble picking clothes!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I used to just wear whatever I found...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: How about this one, perhaps?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh... I remember this. Rosa bought it for me... I bet Mama and Papa would say it's pretty, wouldn't they?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Nff, unf... mmrgh...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: L... Lada, I think you might have it on backwards? Your hood's ended up in front...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Here, I'll turn it around for you.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehe. Thanks, Istina!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Honestly.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're finally seeing your Mama and Papa after so long, and yet you're still so clumsy as you've always been. Will this even do?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I know! It's okay. It's all okay as long as I can see them!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I've recorded all my stories with you and the girls in my books, and I'm going to tell them every single one! And I took a lot of pictures of life at Rhodes! My photo album's thiiis thick!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Also... this! It's a present for them.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Cookie molds...? What shapes are these supposed to be...?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehe, they're all my dearest friends! This one reading is you, Istina, and this one with the headphones is Zima, and the one with the wonky hat is Rosa...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Er, and this horned one...? It can't be Rosalind, can it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: No, that one's Uncle Matterhorn... He spent forever teaching me when I was learning how to make molds, so I put him into the set too!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Leto's is this one with the honey pot!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: All quite detailed, too. You've put a lot of care into these, Lada... Er, don't you have a design for yourself?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hm? If Mama and Papa get to see me and everything... then would they need a mold for me?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: They'll have the real Gummy with them in the flesh, so they won't mind!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, yeah... Istina, what presents are you giving your Mama and Papa?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ah... me?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I... haven't been through the process yet.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You see, suddenly learning they're still alive, and that we can meet again on top of that... It just strikes me as slightly unreal.

spans.text: You see, suddenly learning they're still alive, and that we can
on top of that... It just strikes me as slightly unreal.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Unreal...? I don't get it...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: When I heard they found my parents, I got so happy I couldn't sleep for days, you know!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm very happy too... and very excited, and I'd love to take to them right this instant. But...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Our fraught flight from Chernobog, all the things we went through... then our coming to Rhodes Island, and all after that—we've spent so long living life together.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What news we had of them before never, in the end, went anywhere. If... just if, this time is the same...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Never mind that. We've found them, so... no overthinking it. Let's just sort ourselves out.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lada.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lada! Open the damn door!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, keep it down, wait... Come on, what's this about? Are you just gonna go until you smash the thing open?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sonya!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Allow me.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Lada, would you kindly open the door? Everyone's very worried about you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You've gone almost two days without eating anything... If you keep depriving yourself of sleep like this until your mother and father do come to visit you, you won't even have the energy to greet them. That's no way to...
The dormitory door remains shut. Not a whisper comes. Not a sound answers.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Enough, Natalya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The HR guys said they double-checked and everything. The word on Lada's parents was just another bust. This isn't even the first time they've screwed her hopes up.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: All of us know how goddamned lucky we were to survive Chernobog. Finding our parents and crap... I just think the sooner we get real, the better.

spans.text: All of us know how goddamned lucky
were to survive Chernobog. Finding our parents and crap... I just think the sooner we get real, the better.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: No more giving Lada false hope like that.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Lada's 'rents were off in some other city doing research, right? So we haven't pinned them down yet, whatever. Sooner or later we're gonna find them!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And anyway, didn't you get word on your folks too, Anna?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But given Lada's circumstances, I'm supposing the information about my parents was just as inaccurate.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: ...Anna.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's fine. Even if they are mistaken, it's not as if it means much to me... I suppose.

spans.text: mistaken, it's not as if it means much to me... I suppose.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Enough, no need to give me those looks. I can tell you're worried I'll take it as badly as Lada has.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But look how long we've kept ourselves going already. Even a guarantee that we'd never see our parents again wouldn't turn our lives upside down, would it?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *breathes*... Lada, it's okay.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If you want to stay inside, then please, rest well, and get a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If you feel restless, come find me. We can take some more pictures... If your album is all full up, we'll buy a new one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Or maybe we could draw together? We'll draw those gingerbread monsters we read about, or maybe that huge house the likes of which we'd never imagined, to fit all five of us...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: With a boxing ring, so Sonya and Rosalind can fight to their hearts' content. And a kitchen with an extra-large oven, so Natalya and I can bake cakes with you, and decorate them all in brand new ways.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And remember when you told me, you'd build me a room to fit mountains and mountains of books—

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... Finally. Here you are...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Istina, letter for you...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: For me?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Yep, it just arrived. And the Messenger specifically asked us to get it to you, ASAP...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (The envelope seems fresh; I can still discern traces of overapplied glue on the seal. The inscribed Ursine seems somewhat familiar...)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (The flourish and elegance on this Ursine hand. Something tells me I've seen this before, on the papers of my father's desk, and the annotations in the books by my mother's pillow.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Strange. My heart's suddenly pounding...)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Can it be? It can't, can it...?)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is this letter... from my parents?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: We've inspected, audited and scrutinized, and we can absolutely, positively guarantee. This time, it all lines up.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Rhodes Island's established contact with your parents at a Leithanian branch office... This letter was mailed by them, firsthand.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ah... ah—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What follows is my 65th recording of self-diagnosis and treatment of trauma via in vivo exposure therapy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *exhale*—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm not dreaming after all.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: My parents—are still alive. They're in Leithanien.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: They wrote to me that whenever I'm ready, I can go back to living with them anytime.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'd honestly... never given much thought to the question. Of whether they were alive or dead...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Every time the notion came to me, I'd divert my attention as fast as I could.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I was so sure that they were working at the Government House, and central Chernobog had taken the worst of the damage...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What happened to them had always been plain as day, to me. Frittering energy on getting to the bottom of it would've been meaningless.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Under the supposition that I could never reunite with my parents again, I stayed aboard Rhodes Island, together with Sonya's group.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We took Rhodes Island as a new beginning.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I even drew up a thorough daily schedule for the long-term, so that we could accustom ourselves to our new lives quicker, and so that we could break ourselves free from that nightmare sooner.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We've been studying here, working here, taking part in what missions we can here, and we've been doing well for ourselves.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We've finally been able to... dream a little, about our future...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But... now I've gotten word from my parents out of nowhere. And they're suddenly telling me, I can leave everything behind right now and go back to them, be back with them, just like how it used to be.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What should I do? Should I leave? Leave Rhodes Island, and my USSG comrades...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If perhaps Lada, or Sonya had been the first to find their families again... what would they have done?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Lada's always missed her own Mama and Papa so much, and Sonya may not seem to care, but she, too...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Right... a letter. I can write back to them for now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Tell them I'm not ready to go, for the time being... that I want to stay here.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Come in—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna, you in for dinner? Rosalind says she's treating—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...You writing a letter?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: To your parents?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya, does this part sound right to you? I'll read it out loud...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't wanna hear it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't get it is the thing, Anna. If you've got something to tell 'em, just say it to their faces.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Me, all I'd write is—'Got it. Wait till I get back.'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There, done! Wasn't that easy?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I don't have plans to go to Leithanien at the moment. That's what I'm mulling over how to phrase.

spans.text: I don't have plans to go to Leithanien at the moment. That's

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're not going?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Blyat! Are you kidding me!?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I was helping to sort out the Reception Room visitor files over the next two days, and I still need to write those few book reviews I promised Heidi...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And Rhodes Island's curriculum does demand. There may be no exams, but we won't get away with any less than a good grasp of the knowledge.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And further, didn't we agree that Instructor Dobermann would take us through mission drills next week? The USSG still has plenty on its roadmap for the next six months of operator training, and I imagine...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, is this about Lada?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If it is, you really don't gotta bother.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Lada's... always wanted to see her parents, but we've never found them, and now I've found mine before she...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The hell does it matter that you found yours first? You don't wanna see 'em?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Of course I do. But—coming to Rhodes Island marked the point where I accepted we could never go back to our old lives.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What we should do in the now, where we should go in the future; those have been the persistent factors in my head...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And going back, becoming the apple of my mother's and father's eyes again, the secondary school student—it never crossed my mind.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: In fact, how could it?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Knowing they're alive, and doing well, that's enough for me. That's enough to keep me happy for a very long time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I can maintain a mail correspondence with them for now. We can show each other how we're doing through photographs... and then come vacation, I'll go and see them.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Anna.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm gonna be honest, I've never seen you this confused and screwed up worrying. Not even in Peterheim.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I mean, look at yourself. Who'd guess you just got the biggest, best news of your life?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Doesn't matter what you pick in the end—parents, education, work, our future... All of them matter.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But you've gotta figure out, to you, what's most important of all, right now.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And you don't have to worry about us like that. We're all doing fine on Rhodes.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Look at Lada. She holed up in her room for days, but today, she's gone to the kitchen to tinker out new veggie bakes with Hibiscus.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I passed by the cafeteria just now, and they were laughing the roof off! Lucky I could sprint away...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What's so funny? You wanna try their thing? Green pepper and horned melon in molten piroshki? That sound good to you?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No, something just strikes me different about you today, Sonya. It's like... you're much more talkative, perhaps?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The Sonya I used to know would've torn up my letter and dragged me off in a rush... with probably nothing to add but a 'quit overthinking, it's a pain in the ass.'

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've learned how to comfort people.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Goddammit.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wait... the hell? What are you tearing it up yourself for?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm taking your advice.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm considering, first and foremost, what's most important to me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, hey, no backsies! We agreed this was the last round, right? And I dunno if you saw, but I clearly won!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah, hahahhh *belch*... Sonya, just drink, yeah? That glass, that you just drank before, iiiit doesn't count!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Cause now, now you, haven't drunk this one... so now you, gotta drink it! Urp... *belch*!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Rosalind!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm freaking done here, this is gonna go on forever! Next time, don't care what she says, we don't let her buy that much honey...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Natalya, you drink with her.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Me...? Well, I'm not too fond of honey, you see... I don't even add any to my tea.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? Whaaat, don't tell me you've NEVER tried chugging honey before?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: C'mere—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: W—Wait a seconnmmphh...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Somehow, I feel like this 'farewell party' for me was just a pretense for them to make a ruckus.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Still... this isn't too bad, is it?)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina... here, these are for you!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Eh? For me?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Weren't you going to give these molds to your Mama and Papa?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, umm... I don't get to see them now, do I...? So giving them to you works!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But... won't you have nothing to give the next time you hear about them?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehe! I can make new ones then, it won't take that long!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's carrying a frying pan... is this you, Lada?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mmhm! I made it brand-new! Now there's molds for all five of us.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: When you go home, you can take Gummy and Zima and everyone else with you!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Lada...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Thank you. Once I'm back, I'll have a little present for you too.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wait... Anna, you're coming back?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Erm... I am.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm staying with my parents for a while, and then I'll return.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? Hey, you found your family, go start a new life with them, what are you coming back to... urp—*hic*.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Rosalind, it's not that simple...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is returning to their side going to begin life anew, just like that?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Is it not?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You can't all think that me leaving Rhodes Island is the better option?

steps.name: Rosa & Gummy
steps.text: (Nod)

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Not necessarily the better option, but it is at least an additional one.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Rhodes Island is a fine place, and gave us shelter. But it's because we had nowhere else to go that it became our best option.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But, Anna, things are now different for you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: And besides, wouldn't you imagine that we've all since steeled ourselves for someone to inevitably leave?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Even if we do have to say goodbye someday, I'll still be protecting us, down to the last girl.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Anna.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I guess you might still be worrying about our feelings. But honestly, you finding your family makes us all pretty happy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yeah! You got to find your Mama and Papa, so Gummy's gonna find hers one day too!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: And I think it's gonna be even better for you if you leave Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Umm, it's like...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Well... if I stay here, then I can probably become an amazing cook, and Zima and Leto and Rosa can all be generals in the field...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But you'd probably wanna go back to your Mama and Papa, so you can go back to school and study, right?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I bet your parents are gonna have your acceptance stuff all filed by the time you hit Leithanien. All you gotta do is put on your backpack and head to school, just like back in Chernobog.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And you can live like none of that crap ever happened.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: How can I possibly pretend that...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya. Does starting over really become the best choice in your eyes, the moment you get the opportunity?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Ugh.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well, not for me.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then all the same, it isn't for me, either.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: My decision is made. I'll go there, I'll see how my parents are doing, I'll see if age has taken its toll.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And... I'll likely tell them how dark it was for me in Peterheim, and how I and a group of dependable friends pulled ourselves through it.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And of course, I'll tell them about Rhodes Island. Lada and I have taken countless photos, enough to let them picture our lives here.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And then... I want to ask them and find out, after however they escaped Chernobog, however they reached Leithanien... after all this time, did they ever try searching for me?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Anna, this'll take up so much of the time you have.

spans.text: Anna, this'll take up so much of the time

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You can stay with your parents in your new home, and work out your questions as things come. Nothing's asking you to rush back so quickly.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mm. All of this can be solved as it comes. But none of it is the crux of what I'm going back for.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What's most important—is that I convince them, talk them into letting me back to Rhodes Island, letting me stay with my comrades.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: So... we looked over that old lady's credentials, and noticed she had the surname Morozova, AND she came in from Chernobog!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: And searching for someone in Leithanien who's from Chernobog, that's a back-breaker.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: Luckily, or maybe it was just our dang luck, they were living around the Rhodes Island branch office and came right in to see us that day, because Mrs. Morozova had a bit of a toothache, and they thought our office was a dentist...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: ...and then we learned. Most everyone else treated the events at Peterheim Middle School as... a lost cause.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: But your mom and dad, they never gave up on searching for you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...*exhale*.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So, are they doing well...? What is the place they're living like? Do they have new jobs?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: Mmm, they're good enough. The office's doc has sharp skills, so your mom's tooth won't be aching for the time being at least.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: Once you're there, you can find out the rest for yourself. Take your time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Alright, I see. Thank you so much for going out of your way to take me.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: Don't mention it, you're pretty much on the way. I make regular trips from the landship to branches all over, 'porting goods, linking up with missions.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: And hey, you're not the first I've chauffeured from the landship.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Could you tell me how many you've sent... back to the landship?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Driver
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: This is... Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I've returned here again, as I hoped to.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: On the road to Leithanien, I imagined my reunion with my parents under countless different circumstances... imagined how to convey my decision to them, and show how I'd grown...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But the moment I met them, all the imagining I'd done was pointless. We hugged, we leaned on each other, and then we told one another how our lives had been while we were apart... It was all so natural.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The day I arrived, Papa insisted he'd cook, wanting to make me shchi to bring back the taste of home. After going through several markets, we never found the yellow onions, so we had to buy wild ones to substitute...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It was my first time eating wild onion shchi, and the taste wasn't unbearable... just somewhat pungent.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: They loved Lada's gift, and we used the molds to bake cookies, an endless amount. We spent days eating them...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I mentioned Lada's food was delicious, and Papa seemed to take it personally, insisting he'd find some time to compete with her...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh, right. After the stories I told them and the photos I brought, they know every member of the USSG by name now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What I didn't expect was how wholeheartedly they'd agree to let me stay aboard Rhodes Island. They insisted on giving me an absurd amount of Leithanian things too, to take back to my friends.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: They've all been shared out among the USSG now. You could say... 'polished off' without a trace.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Everything's gone so smoothly. Maybe even a little too smoothly...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, then. 'Self-diagnosis and treatment' no. 66 ends here.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Surely enough, I do mind a little.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: My parents understand and support my decision, but they've expressed their worries and hangups too. They even raised a potential concern I'd never considered before.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: 'What if, in the future, the Self-Government's members all leave Rhodes Island and choose to go their separate ways, to separate places? What do you think you'll do?'

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'll... will I go to Leithanien? Or continue staying aboard Rhodes Island? Or maybe...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: At least, for now, my parents are highly supportive, and my comrades are still by my side. As for what follows... from here on, I'll want to work out my future plans.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Huh? Where's my comms terminal?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: There it is... what was it doing under my bed?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If I recall correctly... Closure's contact is...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Waagh... why ring now of all times...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hello? Ah... it's Closure.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The camcorder? Yes, it was me who borrowed it... No, no need! I'm already done, I'll return it in just a moment...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Say, Closure...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That thing you mentioned before. The one about helping out in the filing room... I'm very thankful you trust me so much.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If it's okay... I'm willing to give it a try.
